prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for choose path screen: Redesign the choose path screen using a spotlight layout that focuses on one onboarding path at a time with clear visual highlights.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
1: [choose_path, copy] Interactive personality companion pitch on app intro: Update the story screen copy to highlight how virtual pets interact with your daily desktop environment.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Meet Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "body": "Discover how a virtual pet can keep you company, boost focus, and brighten your daily work routine right on your screen."}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Split layout redesign with account benefits on sign in: Redesign the sign-in screen into a split layout showing desktop pet cloud sync benefits beside sign-in options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split"}}
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing pet sync restore hint on sign in screen: Add an explicit hint on sign-in clarifying that signing in restores existing pets and saved progress.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your registered account to automatically restore your existing desktop pets and settings."}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive pet preview screen during adoption: Insert a dedicated animation preview screen after picking a friend to showcase pet actions before certificate generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_preview", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"hint": "Preview your pet's desktop behaviors before finalizing adoption."}}
5: [adoption, reorder] Move sign in after pet adoption certificate: Reorder the flow so users create and adopt their pet before signing in to save their progress.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
6: [adoption, layout] Stage layout display for adoption certificate screen: Change the adoption certificate screen to a stage layout showcasing the completed pet certificate prominently.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage"}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desk environment sound player on waiting screen: Add an ambient sound player component on the waiting screen so users can listen to cozy desk audio while generation runs.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Listen to Cozy Ambient Sounds", "action": "play", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop ready notification toggle on waiting screen: Enable a system desktop notification alert option on the waiting screen when pet rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "Your pet is being prepared! We will notify your desktop the moment it is ready."}}
9: [finish, new_flow] Desktop control checklist flow on home welcome screen: Transform the home intro screen into an interactive checklist teaching how to hide, drag, and talk to the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Try moving, hiding, and right-clicking your pet on desktop", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the choose path screen layout inside onboarding is allowed and retains path options.
Story screen copy update introduces the pet without mentioning pricing or breaking rules.
Split layout redesign for sign-in is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a sign-in hint explaining restore functionality is permitted.
Adding a new pet preview screen inside onboarding is explicitly allowed.
Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed.
Stage layout redesign for adoption certificate retains the screen's core job.
Adding an ambient sound player component to the waiting screen is allowed.
Enabling desktop ready notifications on the waiting screen is allowed.
Updating home_intro layout and adding interactive checklist components within onboarding is allowed.
